decisions: The filed hypothesis (incomplete imported signature / return-trial scoring) is OVERTURNED. The symptom stands; the cause is Funcdata::opInsertAfter (funcdata_op.cc:373), which carried a STUB(W3-varnode) where upstream redirects an insertion after an INDIRECT marker to the CALL that marker speaks for. RulePullsubIndirect pulls a SUBPIECE through the guard INDIRECT of the frame slot at -0x2d0 and inserted it INSIDE the call's guard run; collectOutputTrialVarnodes walks back from the CALL and stops at the first non-INDIRECT, so it stopped 18 ops short of the EAX INDIRECT creation and every output trial was marked no-use.

The refuter's 'flags-only consumer of RAX' reading is also overturned: BCryptSetProperty at 0x140004721 has the identical `test eax,eax; js` consumer and recovers its return normally. What separates the two call sites is the interposed SUBPIECE, not the consumer shape.

Two candidate fixes were built and measured. Teaching collectOutputTrialVarnodes to step over a marshalling op at the call's own address also closes the witness at 0/675, but it is a workaround for a documented port stub; completing the redirect fixes the invariant at its source, is upstream's own behaviour, and additionally collapses the copy-shadow and >> 0x20 splices the misplaced op left around every affected call. The redirect shipped; the walk patch was dropped.

The SECOND filed observation is NOT closed. BCryptDecrypt's second argument is still literal 0 after the fix, and none of calloverlap in|full, calleedeadarg, calleearity, peimportcall, framelayout, calleepreserves, spillargtrial or retinputhalf moves it. That half is INPUT-trial recovery for a register whose 4-byte sub-range (EDX, read by SUB R8D,EDX at 0x140004b10) is heritaged separately from the 8-byte RDX the caller wrote at 0x140004a7e. It wants its own need.

No tests/stages/ XML: the trigger needs RulePullsubIndirect to fire on a call's guard INDIRECT while a return trial is still open, and six bytechunk/ELF reductions failed to produce a guarded frame slot (the slot is always proved unaffected or promoted first). The op-list shape is pinned instead by p3_dataflow/kuna_indirectanchor/tests.rs, which builds it against a real Funcdata and asserts both arms, and end to end by tests/cli/bcryptgetproperty-status-tested-through.json.

The acceptance was retargeted from the dataset witness to the vendored mcount_x86_64 fixture (__printf_fp_l loses exactly one of its three hack_digit results) so it can run in CI; acceptance_id relabelled a-b30578566846 -> a-7c5a8a2de1dd. Both were measured PASS on the same build.
